submissions.name: formulaic_commentary
submissions.expect: the Goodhart case: commentary_beyond_restatement passes, and commentary_formulaic is observed anyway so the digest shows it
submissions.text:
The school should have told families about the lockdown much sooner than it did.

The article says that administrators confirmed the front office "waited two hours before sending any message home." This shows that waiting was a bad choice. It shows how the school was not really thinking about what families needed. This is important because it shows why telling families matters, and it shows that the school should have thought about families more.
